programs.name: District 5 Aging and Disability Resource Network
programs.description: Call for help finding long-term services and supports.
programs.eligibility_summary: Navigation for older adults, adults with disabilities and caregivers; individual services have separate rules.
programs.eligibility_decision_owner: Receiving program determines service eligibility.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Call ADRN; describe county, age and support need.
programs.next_step: Call for help finding long-term services and supports.

programs.name: COAAA information and assistance
programs.description: Ask for aging or disability support options in Delaware County.
programs.eligibility_summary: General navigation; program-specific assessment is separate.
programs.eligibility_decision_owner: Receiving program determines service eligibility.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Call COAAA or use its official request-help page.
programs.next_step: Ask for aging or disability support options in Delaware County.

programs.name: HelpLine 211
programs.description: Ask for local health and human-service resources.
programs.eligibility_decision_owner: Individual resource providers decide their own eligibility.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Dial 211 and give the county or ZIP code.
programs.next_step: Ask for local health and human-service resources.

programs.description: Ask for local health and human-service resources.

programs.name: Morrow DD intake and service coordination
programs.description: Ask how to start an age-appropriate developmental-disability eligibility review.
programs.eligibility_summary: County residency and age/developmental-disability requirements are reviewed by the appropriate board or early-intervention team.
programs.eligibility_decision_owner: Morrow county board for board services; early-intervention team for under-3 services.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Ask for an SSA eligibility request for age 3 or older; ask about the separate early-intervention route for a younger child.
programs.next_step: Ask how to start an age-appropriate developmental-disability eligibility review.

public_contact.phone_label: main office; ask for SSA / eligibility

programs.name: Knox DD intake and service coordination
programs.description: Ask how to start an age-appropriate developmental-disability eligibility review.
programs.eligibility_summary: County residency and age/developmental-disability requirements are reviewed by the appropriate board or early-intervention team.
programs.eligibility_decision_owner: Knox county board for board services; early-intervention team for under-3 services.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Age 3+: use the board eligibility page/referral form. Under 3: eligibility page names 614-656-3322 or state referral; EI page lists 740-397-4607 for age 3 or older.
programs.next_step: Ask how to start an age-appropriate developmental-disability eligibility review.

programs.name: Morrow Medicaid application assistance
programs.description: Ask how to apply for Medicaid and who handles the required assessment.
programs.eligibility_summary: Ohio Medicaid rules and assessment apply; no eligibility outcome established.
programs.eligibility_decision_owner: Ohio Medicaid / county JFS for application processing; other assessments may be required.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Ask county JFS about Medicaid applications; use the official Ohio Benefits portal linked by county offices.
programs.next_step: Ask how to apply for Medicaid and who handles the required assessment.

programs.name: Morrow Adult Protective Services
programs.description: Report suspected abuse, neglect or exploitation of an older adult in the community.
programs.eligibility_summary: Published APS route concerns vulnerable adults age 60 or older; agency screens jurisdiction and reports.
programs.eligibility_decision_owner: County APS / statutory investigative authority.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Call county APS or ask JFS for APS; statewide reporting fallback is 855-644-6277.
programs.next_step: Report suspected abuse, neglect or exploitation of an older adult in the community.

programs.name: District 5 Long-Term Care Ombudsman
programs.description: Ask about rights or a concern with nursing-home, assisted-living or home care.
programs.eligibility_summary: For long-term-care consumers and their representatives; consent governs advocacy.
programs.eligibility_decision_owner: Ombudsman program determines advocacy route.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Call District 5 and ask for the ombudsman.
programs.next_step: Ask about rights or a concern with nursing-home, assisted-living or home care.

programs.name: Delaware regional Long-Term Care Ombudsman
programs.description: Ask for resident-directed help with a long-term-care concern.
programs.eligibility_summary: Long-term-care rights and complaints; program reviews the request.
programs.eligibility_decision_owner: Regional ombudsman program.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Call the regional program identified by COAAA.
programs.next_step: Ask for resident-directed help with a long-term-care concern.

programs.name: Ohio State Long-Term Care Ombudsman
programs.description: Ask for an advocate for long-term-care rights or complaints.
programs.eligibility_summary: For long-term-care consumers; advocacy follows resident consent or applicable representative authority.
programs.eligibility_decision_owner: State / regional ombudsman program.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Call the state office for help reaching the correct regional advocate.
programs.next_step: Ask for an advocate for long-term-care rights or complaints.

programs.name: Ohio Long-Term Care Consumer Guide / Quality Navigator
programs.description: Compare published nursing-home and residential-care information.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Use the official Navigator; state ombudsman brochure also points to compass.aging.ohio.gov. Tool could not render the dashboard.
programs.next_step: Compare published nursing-home and residential-care information.
constraints: Interactive dashboard was not usable in this research tool; do not infer closure or current beds.

programs.name: Medicare Care Compare
programs.description: Compare published Medicare provider and quality information.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Use Care Compare to search by location/provider; the CMS nursing-home guide names the route.
programs.next_step: Compare published Medicare provider and quality information.

programs.name: OOD vocational rehabilitation entry
programs.description: Ask OOD how to apply for vocational rehabilitation.
programs.eligibility_summary: For people with disabilities seeking employment support; full criteria not confirmed in this review.
programs.eligibility_decision_owner: Opportunities for Ohioans with Disabilities.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Official OOD homepage excerpt directs applicants to OOD Works; application portal could not be tested.
programs.next_step: Ask OOD how to apply for vocational rehabilitation.

programs.name: Disability Rights Ohio intake
programs.description: Ask about disability rights, discrimination, abuse or access to services.
programs.eligibility_summary: Intake considers the disability-rights issue and organizational priorities; representation is not guaranteed.
programs.eligibility_decision_owner: Disability Rights Ohio intake / legal team.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Call 800-282-9181, option 2, or the official intake route.
programs.next_step: Ask about disability rights, discrimination, abuse or access to services.
constraints: Published intake hours differ across DRO pages. Hours omitted pending clarification.
